author: blu
body: Proves anthems (Lords). A creature whose Oracle text says "creatures you control get +X/+Y" compiles to a TeamBoost static ability; the engine adds it to every creature the controller controls when reading power/toughness. So a 1/1 grunt under a Lord is effectively a 2/2: it wins a fight against a vanilla 1/1 it would otherwise trade with. Remove the Lord and it is a 1/1 again.
